entities.text: High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioner has approached this Court seeking to quash Annexure A2 Final Report in Crime No.222 of 2013 and further proceedings in LP No.37 of 2018 on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Payyoli on the ground of settlement arrived at between the parties.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Payyoli
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Petitioner is the accused and the offences alleged against the petitioner are punishable under Sections 498A and 406 of IPC.
The 2nd respondent is the defacto complainant.
Annexure A3 is the affidavit sworn in by her.

3. The learned Public Prosecutor upon instructions submitted that settlement has indeed been effected between the petitioner and the defacto complainant and that a statement has been provided by the defacto complainant which vouchsafes the fact that the parties have amicably resolved the matter.

4. Heard Smt. Reeha Khader, the learned counsel for the petitioner, the learned Public Prosecutor and Smt.Hasanath, the learned counsel for the defacto complainant/2nd respondent.
5.
The learned counsel for the 2 nd respondent confirms the fact that settlement has been arrived at between the parties.
6. The averments in the Crl.M.C. and the affidavit sworn in 2025:KER:33696 by respondent No.2 would show that the entire disputes between the parties have been settled.

7. In view of the dictum laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Gian Singh v. State of Punjab [(2012) 10 SCC 303] and State of Madhya Pradesh v. Laxmi Narayan [(2019) 5 SCC 688], I am of the opinion that the proceedings against the petitioner can be quashed taking note of the settlement arrived at between the victim and the offender.

entities.text: Gian Singh v. State of Punjab [(2012) 10 SCC 303]
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: State of Madhya Pradesh v. Laxmi Narayan [(2019) 5 SCC 688]
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: No purpose would be served by continuing with the proceedings against the petitioner.
Crl. M.C. is allowed and Annexure A2 Final Report in Crime No.222 of 2013 of Payyoli Police Station and all further proceedings in LP No.37 of 2018 are quashed.

Sd/-
